Name: PC's Floral Wallpapers
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center][line]
A collection of floral wallpapers for the farmhouse. Yep, I like flower *that* much. For those of you who don't, I've another batch of wallpapers planned...[/center][Line]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/uDRI8kv.png[/img][/center]
You can find the wallpapers the usual way, in the vanilla wallpaper catalogue.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/7Jrb1jC.png[/img][/center]
There are five versions of the wallpapers included in the zip file:
[*][b]PC's Floral Wallpaper[/b] – This is the non-paneled version, available in dark, white, and vanilla wood colors.
[*][b]PC's Floral Wallpaper – Panel[/b] – This is the one-panel version, with two panel options: rounded and square. Available in dark, white, and vanilla wood colors.
[*][b]PC's Floral Wallpaper – Panel 2[/b] – This is the two-panel version, with slightly smaller panels than the one-panel version. Available in dark, white, and vanilla wood colors.
[*][b]PC's Floral Wallpaper – Panel 3[/b] – This is the tall-panel version. Available in dark, white, and vanilla wood colors.
[*][b]PC's Floral Wallpaper – Vanilla[/b] – This version uses vanilla wallpaper textures for the wood panel

The files are separated, so you can delete any versions you don't need. Check the "Images" tab for example previews.

This wallpapers would also be included in a tilesheet mod I plan to release hopefully soon.

As always, thank you all for your kindness and support. 


Happy decorating! <3
